description: A React functional component for displaying and adding comments related to a specific task within a project. It manages comment display, form handling, and integrates with server actions to submit new comments.

methods.name: CommentsListAndForm
methods.description: Main React component rendering comments list and comment submission form. Manages local state for comments, form submission status, and errors. Handles form submission by invoking a server action.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission event, prepares form data, calls the server action to create a comment, manages loading and error states, and resets the form upon success.
